description: slicers, Chromium 137+ on /bambu/ (the slicer with the hand-over): cross-origin isolated by Document-Isolation-Policy instead of COOP+COEP, so the tab keeps its opener and name and Boolean3d's Open in slicer can hand a file to the running tab (package/hand-over.js). Another slicer joins by adding its folder once its door has open_files. Way back: disable the rule (enabled: false), or put the earlier headers back.
expression: (http.host eq "slicers.boolean3d.com") and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bambu/")) and (any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"137\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"138\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"139\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"14") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"15") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"16") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"17") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"18") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"19"))

description: slicers: cross-origin isolation (threads need SharedArrayBuffer); every browser the rule above does not take
expression: (http.host eq "slicers.boolean3d.com") and not ((starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/bambu/")) and (any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"137\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"138\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"139\"") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"14") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"15") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"16") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"17") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"18") or any(http.request.headers["sec-ch-ua"][*] contains "\"Chromium\";v=\"19")))
